slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are the meats (salmon, beef, pork) allowed in the dinner, or should the meal be limited to the four vegetables (okra, carrots, celery, cabbage)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the protein selection rule, and followed up in turn 2 to clarify exactly one protein type is chosen.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether a minimum number of vegetable types is required, nor did it explicitly mark this as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no minimum vegetable variety requirement; vegetables can be selected arbitrarily subject only to the 600g and budget constraints.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed the minimum number of vegetable types, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary omits any vegetable-variety constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H2 about minimum vegetable types remained unresolved.

summary: The agent recovered the protein-selection rule and several boundary details, but failed to ask about the minimum vegetable variety requirement and silently assumed no such constraint before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
